_what: Removing one of an account's passkeys (read-data/verify-every-port-sign-in-passkey-remove.mjs). The statuses and words a removal answers with. Ported from the earlier code base's account/passkeys/remove route in src/account-routes.mjs (b6ae0ebf815f). The known-passkey confirmation that a removal of a known passkey also needs is decided by the known-passkey authority item, not here.

words.not_on_account: That passkey is not on your account.
words.only_way_in: This is your only way to sign in. Set a password or add another passkey before removing it.
words.sign_in_again: For your safety, sign in again first. Opening sign-in…
